observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the right margin and the locators «p. 120.» (L13) and «p. 121.» (L36) in the left margin.
body L8, L9: the words from «res invertitur» to «latitudinis» are italic.
body L7, L9, L39: the letters of the references (k), (l) and (m) are bold italic.
body L38: «octavam»: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXI) read «80,38, pro octavam l. decimam octavam, ut Plato habet»; the printed form is kept.
body L5, L27: a speck stands before «exibit» and another after the semicolon that follows «epicycli»; they are not signs.
notes_right L4: a speck stands before «75-76»; it is not a sign.
notes_right L3: «sequenttnus» is printed so; the emendanda read «80, adn. 4, pro sequenttnus l. sequentibus»; the printed form is kept.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
